_description: Copy the Sunbather settings below into atmosphere.helium.sunbather in your main simulation JSON. This is a settings fragment, not a complete observing configuration.

_helium_field_descriptions.telluric_correction: Set atmosphere.helium.telluric_correction to molecfit or sysrem (SYSREM can aggressively remove the planetary signal).
_helium_field_descriptions.sysrem_iterations: For sysrem, supply a positive integer in atmosphere.helium.sysrem_iterations and use uncertainty_mode=conditional. The surrounding pipeline.sysrem_iterations remains zero for the helium route.
_helium_field_descriptions.noise_seed: Set atmosphere.helium.noise_seed to null for fresh independent noise in each new night, or a non-negative integer for reproducible simulations.
_helium_field_descriptions.noise_convention: New helium simulations use normalized-flux uncertainty 1/SNR_pixel and one independent Gaussian draw per exposure and pixel.

_field_descriptions.include_metals: false (default example): H and He only, for quicker exploration. true: include all 28 metals at metal_scale when metal_elements is null. Metals affect the computed temperature and helium populations.
_field_descriptions.metal_scale: Linear metal-to-hydrogen abundance scale relative to solar (1 = solar, 100 = 100 times solar). Applied only when include_metals is true. Choose the enrichment for your planet.
_field_descriptions.metal_elements: null includes all supported metals when enabled. Advanced use: a list of atomic symbols retains only those metals, without redistributing their abundances. H and He are always retained. See the Sunbather composition documentation.
_field_descriptions.hydrogen_number_fraction: The H/(H+He) number fraction remains in the surrounding helium block. Metal abundances are configured separately.
_field_descriptions.stellar_tidal_gravity: false by default. true includes stellar tidal gravity in the Parker wind.
_field_descriptions.parker_mu_tolerance: Relative mean-particle-mass convergence tolerance for a metal-bearing Parker wind (0.01 is the native Sunbather default). Unused with include_metals=false.
_field_descriptions.parker_mu_max_iterations: Maximum Parker/Cloudy mean-mass iterations (7 is the native Sunbather default). Nonconvergence rejects the model. Unused with include_metals=false.
_field_descriptions.parker_initialization: pwinds initializes the mean particle mass using H/He ionisation, then Cloudy accounts for enabled metals. neutral starts from neutral gas instead. Unused with include_metals=false.
_field_descriptions.heating_cooling_factor: Heating/cooling convergence factor for the temperature solution (1.1 in this example).
_field_descriptions.maximum_iterations: Maximum nonisothermal temperature iterations (20 in this example).
_field_descriptions.starting_temperature: constant starts the temperature iteration at Parker T0. free uses Sunbather's native initialization.
_field_descriptions.cosmic_rays: Explicit acknowledgement of the cosmic-ray background used by the native Sunbather solver. Required to be true in this adapter.
_field_descriptions.cloudy_path: Local Cloudy installation directory containing source/cloudy.exe.
_field_descriptions.project_path: New atmosphere output directory. The high-level simulation/grid runner assigns an individual directory to each atmosphere. Existing products are preserved.
